clips.title: The story
paras: Lord Ello Ebonlocke sends Solomon a refusal from Darkshire. His letter rejects the plea for Night Watch aid in Redridge.

Magistrate Solomon asked Duskwood for reinforcements against the blackrock orcs after Stormwind ignored his petitions. Lord Ello Ebonlocke answers with anger and no promise of aid. He reminds Solomon that the Night Watch exists because Stormwind abandoned Darkshire when corrupting magic first gripped the woods. If its defenders leave to help Redridge, Duskwood will be left defenceless and fall to evil before the militia reaches the forest's edge.
